title: trackerPreferredProviderSetting
responsibility: Persist this Tracker host's provider override and apply it at model selection time.

inputs.name: trackerRoutingWithPreference.store
inputs.description: The local Tracker journal that holds the operator override.

inputs.name: trackerRoutingWithPreference.config
inputs.description: Node model routing that supplies the defaults.

inputs.name: trackerPreferredProviderAdmin.store
inputs.description: The local Tracker journal that persists provider changes.

inputs.name: trackerPreferredProviderAdmin.ladderConfig
inputs.description: Live model routing with the persisted preference applied.

inputs.name: trackerPreferredProviderAdmin.now
inputs.description: Clock used to resolve the effective provider.

outputs.name: trackerRoutingWithPreference
outputs.description: Tracker routing with the current persisted preference taking precedence.

outputs.name: trackerPreferredProviderAdmin
outputs.description: Read and update operations for this Tracker host’s provider override.
